seo_discovery_context: Load when public discovery/SEO/analytics surface is touched; M11 remains discovery/measurement authority only.
previous_green_checkpoint: P9 accepted engineering alignment + P10_AI_BLUEPRINT accepted AI development blueprint, subject to carried residuals.
current_repository_artifact_state: Use current repository/artifact state only as implementation evidence/context; never treat static state as runtime/production proof.
in_scope: The named WP plus exact locked module scope, mapped Core findings, applicable dependencies, tests and evidence.
out_of_scope: Unrelated module internals, stale history, new business rules, new authority, unobserved runtime state.
stop_conditions: Missing authority/contract/permission/schema/provider/architecture/physical requirement; unresolved conflict; unsupported identifier; unsafe mutation ambiguity.
testing_evidence: Static + unit + integration + negative/security where applicable; evidence must match the claim; runtime/production claims require actual proof.
context_priority: CURRENT AUTHORITY > ACTIVE WP > HARD DEPENDENCY > ACTIVATED CONDITIONAL > SUPPORTING CONTEXT > HISTORICAL PROVENANCE
